name: Feeding Frenzy
author: CH_HASSAAN
description:
Welcome to Feeding Frenzy, an exciting game where you play as a farmer feeding hungry animals. Your goal is to ensure all the animals are well-fed before they get too hungry. You have 3 chances to feed the animals correctly. Each successful feed increases your score, so be quick and accurate!

Controls:

Movement:
Move Up: W.
Move Down: S.
Move Left: A.
Move Right: D.

Feeding:
Press Space to feed the animals.

How to Play:

Feed the Animals: Move around the farm and feed the hungry animals by pressing the spacebar.
Chances: You have 3 chances to feed the animals correctly. If you miss feeding an animal 3 times, the game is over.
Score: Each successful feed adds to your score. Try to achieve the highest score possible.
